title: submit_review_result schema does not advertise the 200-item cap on filesInspected; large reviews hit a 400 mid-submission
outcome: submit_review_result schema does not advertise the 200-item cap on filesInspected; large reviews hit a 400 mid-submission
acceptance: The review-result submission schema and tool description advertise every server-enforced bound on filesInspected (and any other capped array or string), so a reviewer learns the limit before submitting

A review whose input exceeds the bound has a supported, lossless way to report full coverage (a raised or removed cap, a structured overflow field, or documented chunking), shown by a deterministic test with more than 200 inspected files
The review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher finding, and the full gate passes on the landing input
